correctness.rationale: The basepoint-free map pulls back a line to O(2,2), proving finiteness and degree eight. The eight faithful sign/swap symmetries force a Galois field extension. Characteristic-zero inertia equals the stabilizer along exactly four graph curves; their images are the four lines. The invariant w=x0²y1²−x1²y0² satisfies w²=B(z), determining the normal intermediate quotient. Four transverse lines yield six A1 singularities; adjunction gives K²=2. A standalone exact symbolic checker verifies identities; the universal conclusions rest on theoretical arguments.
